# FAQ-012 Engineering FAQ #12

Revision: Rev A

Q: What is the dust collector pressure drop alarm setpoint for the Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 (EQ-P3-L1-SB02)?
A: The dust collector pressure drop alarm for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 (EQ-P3-L1-SB02) is 2025 Pa. Use this alarm threshold for troubleshooting blocked filters, verifying differential pressure transducer calibration, and scheduling filter change-out per existing maintenance workflow.

Q: What target billet temperature should operators hold for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03)?
A: The target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 1180 °C. Confirm thermocouple placement and logging channels before production; if readings deviate, follow upset response in the process control checklist.

Q: What is the way lube refill interval for Machining CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P3-L3-CN02)?
A: The way lube refill interval for Machining CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P3-L3-CN02) is 70 hours. Record refill events in the equipment log and verify lubricant type and level sight glass at each service.

Q: What austenitizing temperature setpoint is used for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02)?
A: The austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is 855 °C. Validate furnace program and load thermocouple assignments prior to heat cycles; follow metallurgical acceptance criteria for soak time and cooling as applicable.

Q: What is the minimum coil cooling water flow for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03)?
A: The coil cooling water flow minimum for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03) is 72 L/min. Monitor flow interlocks and confirm pump performance when flow approaches the minimum; document any deviations and follow escalation procedures.

Related documents: QS-PROC-08, SB-1033, SOP-P3-L3-02
